[[File:Hypermatter.png|thumb|right|200px|A container of hypermatter]]
{{Quote|Build something around hypermatter, don't be surprised when it blows up.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="SWIH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Hypermatter''' was an exotic form of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] used in the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter annihilators]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and immense [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]]. Its unusual properties allowed vessels to produce the phenomenal amounts of energy necessary for their operation.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="DSn">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Characteristics==
Hypermatter was [[Tachyon/Legends|tachyonic]] matter that existed in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="DSn" /> When constrained by realspace, charged tachyons were annihilated as they accelerated to infinite speed within a reactor. The [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] adjusted the faster-than-light hypermatter particles to allow a ship to jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] without changing its complex mass and energy. The hypermatter annihilation cores were in turn confined by [[Wikipedia:fusion|fusion]] systems.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" />

==History==
Despite its high efficiency, hypermatter still required massive amounts of reactant [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] to power the great starships of the spacelanes. For example, at peak power, the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer's]] main reactor annihilated the equivalent of 40,000 tons of matter each second. Even small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] required significant fuel supplies&mdash;the [[Utapau/Legends|Utapaun]] [[Porax-38 starfighter|P-38 starfighter]] consumed 6.2 kilograms of hypermatter each second at full power.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> Hypermatter was also found in the [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive rings]] used by some [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&ndash;era starfighters.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" /><ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

During the late years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], research into utilizing hypermatter for needs other than starship powering was ramped up considerably. A grant from [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] was given to the Republic [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Ministry of Science]] allowing them to continue research into hypermatter for planetary power, deep-space mining, and other civilian uses.<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|business/1344_2.html|Ministry of Science Continues Hypermatter Studies}}</ref> Some of this research was later used to refine the plans for [[Sienar]]'s [[Expeditionary Battle Planetoid]], which evolved into the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] project.<ref name="DSn" /> The [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] would be powered by and built around a Hypermatter reactor.<ref name="SWICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

Hypermatter instability was a great risk to any process using it, as shown when the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Battle Lance]]'' was vaporized along with its crew, when the improved, prototype hypermatter reactor it was carrying malfunctioned.<ref name="DSn" />
